srList.sentence: The manual segmented dataset (7 cryo-tomograms of FAs) together with the APT workflow is deposited at the Electron Microscopy Public Image Archive under accession code EMPIAR-10570.

srList.sentence: First, a starfile was created only passing the name of each projected subtomogram (rlnImageName) and its originating tomogram (rlnMicrographName) to RELION.

sentenceParts.c: First, a starfile was created only passing the name of each projected subtomogram (rlnImageName) and its originating tomogram (rlnMicrographName) to RELION.

srList.sentence: Negative training images were extracted at random positions from the tomograms, but the volume of the actin bundle was excluded.

sentenceParts.c: Negative training images were extracted at random positions from the tomograms, but the volume of the actin bundle was excluded.

srList.sentence: In the input starfile, the refined psi angles and translations found in the previous step were passed as priors plus for each segment a random rot angle as prior was added (rlnAngleRotPrior) and the tilt prior (rlnAngleTiltPrior) was set to 90deg (He and Scheres, 2017).

sentenceParts.c: In the input starfile, the refined psi angles and translations found in the previous step were passed as priors plus for each segment a random rot angle as prior was added (rlnAngleRotPrior) and the tilt prior (rlnAngleTiltPrior) was set to 90deg (He and Scheres, 2017).

srList.sentence: Furthermore, CTF correction in RELION jobs was switched off, because the tomograms were CTF corrected by phase-flipping prior to subtomogram extraction.
